title: ⑤ 하네스 (skill·rule·spec)
description: .claude 하네스 아티팩트 — repo(공유 hive/셀)·타입별. 현재 개수는 최신 스냅샷, 활동(생성·갱신·churn)은 기간 선택 적용. 데이터=INFRA-ISSUE-272 수집기(일배치).

panels.title: 타입별 현재 아티팩트 수
panels.sql: SELECT dims['artifact_type'] AS type, sum(value) AS cnt FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='harness.artifact_count' AND dt=(SELECT max(dt) FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='harness.artifact_count') GROUP BY dims['artifact_type'] ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: 타입별 분포 (현재)
panels.sql: SELECT dims['artifact_type'] AS type, sum(value) AS cnt FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='harness.artifact_count' AND dt=(SELECT max(dt) FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='harness.artifact_count') GROUP BY dims['artifact_type'] ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: repo×타입 현재 수
panels.sql: SELECT dims['repo'] AS repo, dims['artifact_type'] AS type, sum(value) AS cnt FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='harness.artifact_count' AND dt=(SELECT max(dt) FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='harness.artifact_count') GROUP BY dims['repo'], dims['artifact_type'] ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: 아티팩트 수 추이 (타입별, 일)
panels.sql: SELECT dt, sum(CASE WHEN dims['artifact_type']='skill' THEN value END) AS skill, sum(CASE WHEN dims['artifact_type']='spec' THEN value END) AS spec, sum(CASE WHEN dims['artifact_type']='rule' THEN value END) AS rule FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='harness.artifact_count' AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt

panels.title: 하네스 churn 일별 (line)
panels.sql: SELECT dt, sum(value) AS churn FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='harness.churn_lines' AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt

panels.title: 하네스 생성·갱신 일별
panels.sql: SELECT dt, sum(CASE WHEN metric='harness.artifact_created' THEN value END) AS created, sum(CASE WHEN metric='harness.artifact_updated' THEN value END) AS updated FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric IN ('harness.artifact_created','harness.artifact_updated') AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt
